name: To Winterspring!
objectiveText: Find Starfall Village in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser .

replies: The place is called Starfall Village. Just follow the  road and the signs when you exit tunnel from Felwood/Moonglade

replies:
Through Timbermaw hold at the north end of the zone. If you have done enough TImbermaw quests, they won't be aggro, but I have successfully gotten a level 48 mage through there, even with the aggro ... liberal use of Blink. My hunter, at about the same level, died twice, but still got to the other side.

If you ever plan to make nice with the Timbermaw, you do not want to fight them if they aggro on you. It's an ugly faction grind as it is without taking steps backwards.

There is a guy outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold that offers a quest.  You can take that, kill a bunch of guys near by and get and get your reputation up to unfriendly pretty quickly, then they won't attack.
